Episode 253. Gathering Once Again in Lafrarosa (7)
[Graaaahh...!]
Beltian continued to let out roars.
However, the rays of light from the restraints binding him only trembled slightly and showed no signs of coming loose.
'Is it almost over? If it weren't for Bligiet's change of heart, this would have been quite difficult.'
The memory of the beginning that Bligiet possessed.
If it weren't for that, this situation could not have been created so easily.
Beltian would have resisted much more strongly, and therefore, the Zipfel and Ganesto would not have missed their chance in the end.
[Bligiet, I curse you! You are not worthy of being me!]
Bligiet, who had been acting like a terrified chick the whole time, suddenly strode towards Beltian, who was being bound by the restraints.
Thwack! He then struck him on the head with all his might and shouted.
[What ungrateful words are these, after I went out of my way to save you, Beltian. If it weren't for me, you would have self-destructed and disappeared. It was I who gave you a chance.]
[Stop spouting nonsen—!]
[Ah, since we're going to be family now anyway, it would be good to decide the hierarchy in advance. From now on, you are under me. Got it?]
[You act like a filthy mortal, uh, ack.]
[This, again, you, this, this! Still can't get a grip? Don't you get it? Right now, only I can attack you one-sidedly. Take this here, and here too!]
[Ugh, Kraaah, ughhh!]
While a childish fight that was hard to believe was between the creators of this world continued, the fleets created by the Zipfel were continuously being shot down in the skies nearby.
{[Young Patriarch, the restraint is complete! The operation is a success.]}
Soon, Jin received the communication from Lueth, nodded, and looked around.
The Zipfel immediately realized that they no longer had a chance and stopped creating troops, and the chaotic energy of the Ganestos could no longer be felt at all.
He could also see the destroyed landscape of Lafrarosa.

The main hall of the Battle God Temple looked almost like a ruin as its entire ceiling had collapsed, but overall, the city was in a much less damaged state than the Vamel Alliance had initially expected.
Lafrarosa was like a second hometown to Jin.
If it had been destroyed to the point of no return or if the reconstruction time was uncertain, Jin would have been deeply hurt as well.
It was all thanks to Bligiet.
Jin was now looking at him with a favorable gaze for the first time.
Beltian.
Among the great powers that had once again gathered in Lafrarosa to secure him, the victor, this time as well, was the Vamel Alliance.
“Bligiet.”
[Why do you call?]
“Your contribution was great. Honestly, I was on the fence about whether I could trust you, but you did very well.”
At those words, Bluggiet briefly smiled, then his face hardened and he glared at Jin.

[Thank you very... that's not it. Tsk! And yet, is this disrespectful attitude all you show me? The reason I decided to bet everything on you is only because I recovered the memory of the beginning, so don't you dare think of ordering me around like a servant.]

“Once more trust is built, and we are able to prevent the sacrifice of more innocent people thanks to your abilities, then I will treat you as an elder of the coalition. For now... please be satisfied with me using polite speech towards you.”
Jin was quickly grasping Bluggiet's suddenly changed personality. He was clearly the type who worked well only when shown a moderate amount of respect.
He also showed a childish side, getting all excited when he was acknowledged for something.
[Hmph, well... it's not satisfactory, but I will understand for now. Since there is the matter of my position. Know that... I am not doing this because I find you particularly pretty or anythi
ng.]
“Yes, you have worked hard.”
Vahn, Murakan, and the executives of the coalition who had descended from the Golden Fleet's flagship were approaching Beltian one by one.
Beltian seemed to have almost lost consciousness, but he woke up around the time everyone started staring at him up close.
[Kgggh...]
[Are you awake, friend.]
[Araxion and Malugia... and the egos who share my will, they will eventually lead you all to ruin.]
[That's a very good mindset. Keep remembering that hatred. That's the only way you'll be able to keep producing power.]
[You baaastard!]
[You will soon realize that you have no choice but to cooperate with us.]
[You must think that Araxion and Malugia are captured by mortals just like you and I, and cannot come to save me.]

[Not at all? Araxion might be, but Malugia is likely just pretending to be captured by those things called the Zipfel. However, in that process, Malugia's power will inevitably be damaged to some extent. She cannot handle these mortals on her own.]
[Bligiet, you... what are you plotting. What are you going to do by gathering those who were once with us?]
At those words, Bligiet looked at Jin.

“To stop the world from being damaged and destroyed by someone, that is all. And our Vamel Alliance will never let you go from now on, so it would be better for you to adapt as quickly as Lord Bligiet has, Beltian.”
The moment the word 'Lord' Bliggiet came from Jin's mouth, the coalition members nearby flinched and glanced back and forth between him and Bluggiet.
As for Bluggiet, he couldn't help but shrug his shoulders.
The world of Lokia.
Joshua sought out the 'Creator's Space' with a sorrowful face.
There, he saw Lokia Ganesto in her original form, and the figure of the unconscious Hailyn Runcandel.
“...The knights have failed, Mother. In the end, Beltian has fallen into Jin's grasp.”
“It was something I almost certainly expected, so there is no need to be so gloomy, Joshua. In any case, sending the children this time was nothing more than banking on luck.”
“Luck... you say?”

“Yes. Because Jin Runcandel has always had luck on his side, I had hoped that for once, the world would smile upon us too. As expected, it only shows me its expressionless face. No, is it beyond that, at a level of mockery?”
While Joshua was silent, trying to fathom her meaning, Lokia stroked Hailyn's hair once and then rose from her seat.

“Still, if there's a silver lining, it's that. If Beltian had met his annihilation, our means to negotiate with the Demon Army would have vanished. For now, the reason for the Demon Army not to dispose of this dimension clearly remains.”
“The Demon Army... do they possess a power so great that they can dispose of this entire dimension at any time?”

“If they can overcome the restrictions of interdimensional interference, then it can be seen as so. In that case, it probably wouldn't even take an hour for our world to disappear from the list of dimensions. They just have to erase the record. It's not at that level right now. However, if the unified Zipfel's Kelliark and the Demon Army' elite were to invade directly, that too would be sufficiently catastrophic."
“I don't want to admit it, but the current Runcandel and Vamel Alliance that Jin has built are clearly the strongest in the mortal world.”

“Yes, it could be a good fight. And if luck follows and a miracle occurs as always, the Vamel Alliance might even win. But it would be a victory fraught with wounds, and even that would be nothing more than a victory in a battle, not the war. The unified Zipfel isn't sending their entire force anyway. They have a next time, but the Vamel Alliance can only fight properly once.”
“It is just a pity that the youngest and the Vamel Alliance do not understand your will, Mother.”
Mother's will, Lokia's objective.
Lokia smiled meaningfully and met Joshua’s gaze.
“Do you now understand me, Joshua?”
“Of course. I have understood since the day you first awakened me, Mother. You intend to return this world to a time when there was only one dimension, and create a more just future.”
“Will that satisfy my thirst?”
“...Pardon?”
“Instead of interfering in all sorts of ways with the world I created as its creator like now... as a normal member of a just world, will I be able to enjoy that light?”
“I will surely make it so. For you, Mother, I am prepared to do anything.”

“I shall look forward to the moment when I am genuinely moved by those words someday. More importantly, Joshua. In my opinion, the reason Jin and that child's companions did not annihilate Beltian in this battle is because my information was leaked.”
“Surely not, do you mean they tracked your meeting with Kelliark with recording magic?”

“No, there were no such traces. It was probably the dream ability of the Demons. From now on, we must move with the assumption that the Vamel Alliance and Kinzelo have overheard my entire conversation with Kelliark. This too is not a problem. In fact, there are parts that turned out well. After all, some of that was information I intended to let them know anyway. That they should not annihilate the egos of the Sun God was one of them.”
It hurt her pride to have been bested by a mere 'dream ability' due to her recent series of reckless actions, but for Lokia, it wasn't all bad.

“From now on, the Vamel Alliance will try not to annihilate any of the egos of the Sun God. In a way, we have become safer from the disposal of the Demon Army. As things stand now, it might be better for the Vamel Alliance to secure all the egos of the Sun God. Even if Malugia is unavoidable.”
“...If that happens, won't they be able to track us easily?”

“Since there were several misjudgments and mistakes before, we have no choice but to take on that much more risk. However, the only person who knows the true significance of the Sun God's resurrection is me. Even if they secure most of the egos, they do not know how to use them.”
The true significance of the Sun God's resurrection was a detail that had not yet been shared even with Joshua.
Joshua silently lowered his head, not asking what it meant, though he was curious.

“In any case, now that Beltian has entered the grasp of the Vamel Alliance, as soon as he begins to cooperate, the speed at which the coalition can track the Tower of Story will also increase. Just as I was able to find the Tower of Tales immediately thanks to Araxion. We will have to make adjustments from now on, so that Kelliark does not die before the opportune moment arrives.”
